review:
Harlequin Carnival is a 5x3 carnival slot with three-row Harlequin xNudge Wilds that can land on any reel and nudge into full view, adding +1 per step. In Harlequin Respins, these wilds walk one reel left with each respin until they reach the first reel.

Three bonus symbols award eight Harlequin Bonus spins, with an assured Harlequin wild on reel 5 starting at x3. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 5,861x cap. The walking xNudge wilds are a good fit for each other.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
